title: Metthew Shard Manifest v1.1
description: v1.1 adds the high-end tier: `tier`, `capabilities` and `sim_hz`, plus `golden_run.headless`. All four are OPTIONAL, so every v1 manifest still validates. Tick audits on tool-runner invariants live in tools/metthew_validate.py, where they can name the field that failed; a draft-07 conditional could not report the partition breach as a sentence.

id.description: Content-addressed shard ID: name@sha256:hash of the full bundle (manifest + files). Host-version fallback allowed during transition.

genre.description: Genre determines which validator gates apply. Doc-only shards have zero code.

tier.description: Target class (v1.1). `lowend` keeps every v1 gate: 24 files, 2 MiB payload, p99 < 33.3 ms. `highend` may exceed those but must declare its capabilities and a headless golden run. `any` is a v1 shard that has not been classified and is judged as lowend.

files.description: All files in the shard. The 24-FILE CEILING IS NOW A LOW-END GATE, not a wire limit: v1 could not express a high-end bundle at all, and the deeper dive had already measured the 24-file rule wasting 64% of its own capacity. tools/metthew_validate.py enforces 24 for tier lowend/any and 1024 (with the payload cap) for tier highend.

entrypoint.description: Relative path to the entrypoint file (must be listed in files[] with role=code)

loader.description: Execution model loader. wasm3-det = Wasm 3.0 host, deterministic profile, threads+SIMD off. native = reserved for future host-version fallback.

sim_hz.description: Authoritative simulation rate (v1.1). The golden run ticks at this rate, and the tick budget is judged against it: p99_ms must stay under one tick (1000/sim_hz). A high-end shard at 120 Hz has 8.33 ms; the same shard at 30 Hz has 33.3 ms. Rendering above the sim rate is presentation and never part of the hash.

input.description: Base64-encoded fixed input bytes for the golden run

ticks.description: Deterministic tick count for the golden run

state_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the full state after the golden run ticks

token.description: Golden token printed on stdout by a valid golden run

headless.description: v1.1: the hash was taken with PRESENTATION DISABLED. Required (explicitly true) for tier highend, because a hash taken with an upscaler, a frame generator or a denoiser in the pipeline is a hash of the painter, not of the game. Also required whenever any declared capability is presentation-side and not exact.

golden_run.description: The golden self-test: fixed input, fixed ticks, fixed state hash, fixed token.

id.description: Capability identifier, e.g. path-tracing, neural-upscale, frame-generation, mesh-culling, fixed-point-physics, recorded-input-transcript.

affects.description: Which side of the determinism partition this capability sits on. `sim` capabilities are inside the golden run's hash; `presentation` capabilities are outside it by construction.

determinism.description: `exact` = bit-identical on every host; `seeded` = identical from a declared seed but host-dependent in the last bits; `approximate` = a different picture each run. Only `exact` may be on the sim side.

capabilities.description: The determinism partition (v1.1). This is the field that lets a path-traced, frame-generated shard be verifiable at all: its beauty is declared presentation-side, so the golden run can be run headless and still be a proof.

hubs.description: Declared shared libraries (hubs). Each hub is versioned and content-addressed. The validator counts coupling instead of hiding it.

payload_bytes_max.description: Max packed payload size. 2 MiB default and ceiling for tier lowend/any; tier highend may declare up to 8 GiB, and the declared value is checked against the sum of files[].size_bytes.

tick_budget_ms.description: Measured tick cost from M-02 bench on the reference box, per scene. p99 must stay under one sim tick: < 33.3 ms at 30 Hz, < 16.7 ms at 60 Hz, < 8.33 ms at 120 Hz.

budget.description: Measured budget gates from M-02. Provisional numbers in the plan are replaced by readings.

licence.description: SPDX licence identifier (e.g., MIT, CC0-1.0, Unlicense). Per-asset provenance in files[] overrides this.

author_pubkey.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 public key of the author. Used for signed result files (M-09) and bundle verification.

execution_model.description: Execution model. resident_host = one process per shard with fixed-step loop and message boundary (required for 720p/30 on low-end, and for any shard whose sim must hold a tick budget). one_shot = call-per-tick via polyglot (only fits Python/JS). Must be resident_host for M-05 reference shards.

env_allowlist.description: Explicit list of environment variable keys the shard may read. Default empty — current polyglot path hands over the player's entire environment (secrets leak). A wildcard entry defeats the allowlist and is refused.

tick_budget.description: Alias of budget.tick_budget_ms for top-level access. p99 must stay under one tick at the declared sim_hz.

competitive.description: Opt-in determinism tax. When true, the validator enforces per-tick hash chain and replay verification. Solo, puzzle, and doc-only shards should leave this false.

provenance.description: Per-asset provenance: raw+sha+url+tier (same discipline as FETCH_LOG). Does not create an arbiter, but makes 'where did this sprite come from' answerable.
